THE LAMP KEEPER

CHAPTER ONE

Nilay climbs the stair with the oil can.
The lamps are old and the wicks are short,
and the stair turns twice before the top.

Her brother Emre waits at the bottom.
He does not like the dark, and Nilay
knows it better than anyone in the house.

Chapter Two

Nilay sits on the threshold at night
and listens to the air shaft breathe,
slow and even, like a sleeper.

Emre brings her tea and does not speak.
She drinks it slowly and counts the
breaths until the lamps are kept.
